input_semantics: Each decimal JSON numeric input denotes its nearest binary64, integrated at its exact rational value.
derivation: Conditional on being active, lambda is Gamma(r+x, alpha+T) and p is Beta(a, b+x). E future | active = integral over p of (1-(1+p*h/(alpha+T))^-(r+x))/p times the beta posterior. Multiply by the posterior active probability.
method: mpmath tanh-sinh posterior integral; no Rust or native evaluation

cases.note: either side of the 100000-term limit of the transformed series
inside the near-one band at large r
inside the near-one band at large r
both sides of the rounding guard
